import numpy as np
L=np.log(P)
base=[np.ones_like(P),t,P,t*P,P**2,P*L,t*P*L,t*L,t**2]
best=None
for lam in np.linspace(-1,1,401):
    if abs(lam)<1e-9: continue
    e=np.exp(lam*t)
    X=np.column_stack(base+[e,e*P,e*P*L,e*P**2])
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
    err=np.mean((dP_dt-X@c)**2)/np.var(dP_dt)
    if best is None or err<best[0]: best=(err,lam,c)
print(best[0],best[1]); print(np.round(best[2],4))
